summary: The Challenge Roadmap rev 2.0 (owner-approved 2026-10-02) becomes Carbon's standing challenge development pipeline (OWNER-CHALLENGE-ROADMAP-01): Prioritize, Design, Test/iterate and Rank for deployment, one common test suite, 26 families in three-factor priority order. Its text is Design_Specs/Challenge_Roadmap.md; its families are transcribed exactly into carbon/challenge_pipeline/, which ports the roadmap page's queue, false-feasible bound and leaderboard and validates the protocol, rubric and per-family records against the roadmap's rules (no family past queued before protocol lock, each stage behind its named owner's sign-off, results only from a frozen run, solve times only from the reference hardware, rubric thresholds unset until approved). Phase 1 starts: battery defines the protocol in eight steps. The cold plate, motor and photonic coupler become prior work for their families. Open owner question: roadmap §03/§06 say JAX-only, OWNER-PYTORCH-BACKEND-01 admits PyTorch recipes; suite v1's admission vector keeps the backend set open until decided. No qualification, reward, deployment or LIVE authority.
